seoTitle: How to Copy a Jotform to Another Account (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Copy a Jotform form from one account into another using its public share link and Jotform's Import Form tool, without rebuilding fields from scratch.
intro: Rebuilding a form field-by-field every time you need it in a different Jotform account wastes time you don't have to spend. Jotform actually lets you clone a form from a public URL directly into a new workspace, keeping your layout, fields, and widgets intact. Here's how to move a form between accounts in just a few clicks.

steps.heading: Grab the source form's share link
steps.body: Open the form in its original account and copy the public sharing link from the Quick Share option.

steps.heading: Log into the target account
steps.body: Sign into the Jotform account you want to copy the form into.

steps.heading: Start a new form
steps.body: Click Create Form from the sidebar to begin the setup wizard.

steps.heading: Choose Import Form from a web page
steps.body: Select the Import Form option, then pick the 'From a Web Page' tool inside the setup window.

steps.heading: Paste the URL and create the clone
steps.body: Paste the copied form link into the URL field and click Create Form to generate an independent duplicate.

steps.heading: Verify the copied layout
steps.body: Open the new form in Form Builder to check that fields, styling, and widgets carried over correctly.

faq.question: Do I need admin access to the original account?
faq.answer: No — as long as you have the form's public sharing link, you can import it into a new account without needing login access to the source account.

faq.question: Will the copy include conditional logic or widgets?
faq.answer: The import process is designed to pull in the full layout, including fields and widgets, though it's worth reviewing the copied form to confirm everything transferred as expected.

faq.question: Is the copied form linked to the original in any way?
faq.answer: No, once imported the new form is a completely independent copy — edits to one won't affect the other.

faq.question: Can I do this on a free Jotform plan?
faq.answer: The Import Form feature is accessible from the standard form creation wizard, so it should be available regardless of plan, though usage limits still apply based on your account tier.
